author: Campaign
name: Witcher
short: A dark-fantasy text campaign with saves, DMs, and staff channel gates.
description: Original-prose text RPG on the Wild Hunt road: main path, major side contracts, Hearts of Stone, Blood and Wine, and PG-13 fade-to-black romance. Progress is stored on the user id. Server play requires staff to enable each channel.
install_msg: Load with [p]load witcher. Staff enable a channel with [p]witcherset enable. Players start with [p]witcher play. Romance fades to black and can move to DMs.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user id, quest flags, inventory, resume codes, output mode, and an 18+ opt-in flag in Red config.
